exposure: Two bioinformatics approaches (OTU and paired end)
Three hypervariable regions of the 16S rRNA gene ((V1 + V2 + V3), (V4 + V5) and (V6 + V7 + V8))
finding: A longer bead-beating step was required for optimal bacterial DNA extraction from ELBW faecal samples, and sequencing regions (V1 + V2 + V3) and (V6 + V7 + V8) provided the most representative taxonomic profiles.
